status_as_of_cutoff: Approved-permitted at the land-use level, but not verified as under construction. The 119.9-acre LC West rezoning/CUP track was Board-approved in October 2024 after Planning Commission denial. The 61.8-acre Newport Equities rezoning and CUP were approved 5-0 by the Board of Supervisors on October 27, 2025, creating a county-described combined 181-acre, planned 2,000,000-square-foot campus. County minutes state energy needs would be 300-400 MW and that the applicant had a Dominion will-serve but no guarantee; JLL's November 13, 2025 release says Dominion Energy will energize the campus with an initial 365 MW deployment. Powhatan commercial permit logs listed through June 2026 did not show a LC West, Newport, Province, tax-map, Page Road, or data-center building permit entry; no CO, construction start, or utility/environmental completion record was found.

County press release states the Newport approval follows the 2024 120-acre approval and creates a combined 181-acre, planned 2,000,000-square-foot data center campus with utility-improvement proffers and 75-foot/90-foot height limits.
JLL states the campus is Powhatan Technology Park, has 500kV/230kV/115kV transmission lines on site, and is expected to receive an initial 365 MW Dominion Energy deployment.

County commercial permit-log index lists monthly reports through June 2026; searched January-June 2026 logs for LC West, Newport, Province, data center, Page Road, and tax-map identifiers without finding a project building permit entry.
